objective: Iniciar el frente CxC Decisión/Análisis con auditoría SQL canónica de solo lectura. Determinar si ya existen fuentes, tablas, vistas, procedimientos, endpoints y claves para Cuentas por Cobrar, cartera, clientes, documentos, saldos, vencimientos, pagos/cobros, límites de crédito, antigüedad, promesas/decisiones de cobranza, riesgo y RBAC. No crear nada antes de identificar qué se reutiliza. No DDL/DML, no Mongo, no LIVE externo, no Producción.

queries.name: cxc_candidate_objects
queries.sql: SELECT s.name AS schema_name,o.name AS object_name,o.type_desc FROM sys.objects o JOIN sys.schemas s ON s.schema_id=o.schema_id WHERE o.is_ms_shipped=0 AND (o.name LIKE '%CxC%' OR o.name LIKE '%Cuenta%Cobrar%' OR o.name LIKE '%Cobran%' OR o.name LIKE '%Cartera%' OR o.name LIKE '%Cliente%' OR o.name LIKE '%Credito%' OR o.name LIKE '%Factura%' OR o.name LIKE '%Cobro%' OR o.name LIKE '%Pago%Cliente%' OR o.name LIKE '%Antig%' OR o.name LIKE '%Venc%' OR o.name LIKE '%Saldo%' OR o.name LIKE '%Riesgo%') ORDER BY s.name,o.type_desc,o.name

queries.name: cxc_candidate_columns
queries.sql: SELECT s.name AS schema_name,t.name AS table_name,c.column_id,c.name AS column_name,ty.name AS data_type,c.max_length,c.precision,c.scale,c.is_nullable,c.is_identity FROM sys.tables t JOIN sys.schemas s ON s.schema_id=t.schema_id JOIN sys.columns c ON c.object_id=t.object_id JOIN sys.types ty ON ty.user_type_id=c.user_type_id WHERE s.name='dbo' AND (t.name LIKE '%CxC%' OR t.name LIKE '%Cuenta%Cobrar%' OR t.name LIKE '%Cobran%' OR t.name LIKE '%Cartera%' OR t.name LIKE '%Cliente%' OR t.name LIKE '%Credito%' OR t.name LIKE '%Factura%' OR t.name LIKE '%Cobro%' OR t.name LIKE '%Pago%' OR t.name LIKE '%Antig%' OR t.name LIKE '%Venc%' OR t.name LIKE '%Saldo%' OR t.name LIKE '%Riesgo%') ORDER BY t.name,c.column_id

queries.name: cxc_indexes
queries.sql: SELECT t.name AS table_name,i.name AS index_name,i.is_primary_key,i.is_unique,i.type_desc,c.name AS column_name,ic.key_ordinal,ic.is_included_column FROM sys.tables t JOIN sys.indexes i ON i.object_id=t.object_id LEFT JOIN sys.index_columns ic ON ic.object_id=i.object_id AND ic.index_id=i.index_id LEFT JOIN sys.columns c ON c.object_id=t.object_id AND c.column_id=ic.column_id WHERE i.is_hypothetical=0 AND (t.name LIKE '%CxC%' OR t.name LIKE '%Cobran%' OR t.name LIKE '%Cartera%' OR t.name LIKE '%Cliente%' OR t.name LIKE '%Credito%' OR t.name LIKE '%Factura%' OR t.name LIKE '%Cobro%') ORDER BY t.name,i.is_primary_key DESC,i.is_unique DESC,i.name,ic.key_ordinal

queries.name: cxc_foreign_keys
queries.sql: SELECT pt.name AS parent_table,pc.name AS parent_column,fk.name AS fk_name,rt.name AS referenced_table,rc.name AS referenced_column FROM sys.foreign_keys fk JOIN sys.foreign_key_columns fkc ON fkc.constraint_object_id=fk.object_id JOIN sys.tables pt ON pt.object_id=fkc.parent_object_id JOIN sys.columns pc ON pc.object_id=pt.object_id AND pc.column_id=fkc.parent_column_id JOIN sys.tables rt ON rt.object_id=fkc.referenced_object_id JOIN sys.columns rc ON rc.object_id=rt.object_id AND rc.column_id=fkc.referenced_column_id WHERE pt.name LIKE '%CxC%' OR pt.name LIKE '%Cobran%' OR pt.name LIKE '%Cartera%' OR pt.name LIKE '%Cliente%' OR pt.name LIKE '%Credito%' OR pt.name LIKE '%Factura%' OR pt.name LIKE '%Cobro%' OR rt.name LIKE '%Cliente%' OR rt.name LIKE '%Unidad%' OR rt.name LIKE '%Empresa%' ORDER BY pt.name,fk.name

queries.name: cxc_balance_due_signals
queries.sql: SELECT t.name AS table_name,c.name AS column_name,ty.name AS data_type FROM sys.tables t JOIN sys.columns c ON c.object_id=t.object_id JOIN sys.types ty ON ty.user_type_id=c.user_type_id WHERE (t.name LIKE '%CxC%' OR t.name LIKE '%Cobran%' OR t.name LIKE '%Cartera%' OR t.name LIKE '%Cliente%' OR t.name LIKE '%Credito%' OR t.name LIKE '%Factura%' OR t.name LIKE '%Cobro%') AND (c.name LIKE '%Saldo%' OR c.name LIKE '%Monto%' OR c.name LIKE '%Importe%' OR c.name LIKE '%Fecha%' OR c.name LIKE '%Venc%' OR c.name LIKE '%Pag%' OR c.name LIKE '%Cob%' OR c.name LIKE '%Credito%' OR c.name LIKE '%Limite%' OR c.name LIKE '%Estado%' OR c.name LIKE '%Estatus%') ORDER BY t.name,c.column_id

queries.name: cxc_decision_risk_signals
queries.sql: SELECT s.name AS schema_name,o.name AS object_name,o.type_desc FROM sys.objects o JOIN sys.schemas s ON s.schema_id=o.schema_id WHERE o.is_ms_shipped=0 AND (o.name LIKE '%Promesa%' OR o.name LIKE '%Decision%Cob%' OR o.name LIKE '%Gestion%Cob%' OR o.name LIKE '%Riesgo%' OR o.name LIKE '%Scoring%' OR o.name LIKE '%Mora%' OR o.name LIKE '%Antig%Saldo%' OR o.name LIKE '%Aging%') ORDER BY s.name,o.type_desc,o.name

queries.name: cxc_rbac_signals
queries.sql: SELECT t.name AS table_name,c.name AS column_name,ty.name AS data_type FROM sys.tables t JOIN sys.columns c ON c.object_id=t.object_id JOIN sys.types ty ON ty.user_type_id=c.user_type_id WHERE (t.name LIKE '%Usuario%' OR t.name LIKE '%Rol%' OR t.name LIKE '%Permiso%' OR t.name LIKE '%Acceso%') AND (c.name LIKE '%Usuario%' OR c.name LIKE '%Rol%' OR c.name LIKE '%Permiso%' OR c.name LIKE '%Unidad%' OR c.name LIKE '%Empresa%' OR c.name LIKE '%Activo%') ORDER BY t.name,c.column_id
